column1: # group_of.tsv — a camera's source and the group the platform puts it in (`placement.group_by: {field: source, cut_at:
# host, schemes: …}` of vms.subsystem.yaml; `w2cplatform.spec.url_host`), read by tests/test_group_of_table.py.
# The group is the HOST the source names, in one spelling: neither the scheme nor the port is part of it; lower case, no
# trailing dot; an IP as written once (IPv6 unbracketed, RFC 5952, no zone; IPv4-mapped as IPv4); a percent-escape in a
# host is not decoded. (none): no group — not a host, or not an address. «Паритет» replaces this file with the table
# Columns, tab-separated: the source; its group, or (none); `refused` when the source field refuses it as a value
# (`refusal`: its `secret_in` and address rules) and the group is there all the same — refusing is the field's, grouping is group_by's;
# one host, whatever the scheme and the port
